name: backroom
description: Agentic back office for local cafes: self-healing browser skills, temporal business memory, measured benchmarks.

scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright && uv run pytest
scripts.check:web: pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck
scripts.dev: pnpm dev:db && concurrently -k -n api,portals,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:portals" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:lite: concurrently -k -n api,portals,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:portals" "pnpm dev:web"
